neighbours.label: A colon opening a list of qualities after a statement of taste or looks ('the kind of book I enjoy:', 'awful to see:'); the same statement without the colon, and colons in labels and times, stay quiet. Second round: narrowed after 'one thing left to do:' did not fire
fire: It has all the features I want: a fast chip, a good screen and long battery life.
This is the sort of song I love: slow, sad and simple.
Their boots were terrible to behold: torn, muddy and worn.
It is the kind of place I like: quiet, green and cheap.
The meal had everything we crave: salt, fat and spice.
The room was ugly to look at: peeling paint and stained carpet.
It is just the type of story I adore: strange, dark and brief.
She has the qualities I admire: honesty, wit and patience.
quiet: It has all the features I want, and the price is fair.
This is the sort of song I love to play at home.
Their boots were terrible to behold and smelled of mud.
It is the kind of place I like to visit in spring.
The meal had everything we crave, so we stayed late.
The room was ugly to look at, so we left.
Time left: 3:45 on the clock in the hall.
Note: she has the key to the front door.

short: colon after a taste or looks statement
